title: Render info snapshot, schema version 1 (VIZ.RENDER.FRAME.TIER, view.get_render_info@1)
description: Renderer capability tier, active backend, adapter, driver, point-raster path, transparency path, frame-time and GPU memory budgets, and displayed/total point and triangle counts of the last presented frame. Serialised as RFC 8785 canonical JSON.

tier.description: Capability tier: T0 (64-bit atomics + compute), T1 (compute without 64-bit atomics), T2 (no compute), T3 (headless server stills).

adapter.description: Adapter name reported by the graphics backend.

driver.description: Driver name and version info reported by the graphics backend.

points.description: Displayed and total point counts of the last presented frame.

triangles.description: Displayed and total triangle counts of the last presented frame.
